# Reeltern

> Local, reversible video editing for people and MCP assistants. Early preview; original media is preserved. Stdio transport, 21 tools, optional local Ollama drafts, supplied transcripts, verified renders. No built-in speech recognition or public HTTP server.

## Use
- [Release downloads](docs/releases.md): OS Python bundles, wheel/source packages and the tested environment matrix.
- [README](README.md): Installation, demo and current capabilities.
- [Client setup](docs/clients.md): Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code and generic stdio configuration.
- [Agent operating guide](docs/agent-workflow.md): Actual tool sequence, source evidence, revisions, polling and errors.
- [MCP tools](docs/mcp.md): Tool index and semantics.
- [Machine-readable schemas](docs/mcp-tools.json): Generated input/output tool schemas.
- [Editorial agent](docs/editorial-agent.md): Optional local inference and caption limitations.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): Installation, locks, errors and captions.

## Build
- [Contributor instructions](AGENTS.md): Shared coding-agent guidance.
- [Implementation](docs/implementation.md): Code map, contracts, feature changes and release process.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): Storage, timing, rendering and integrity.
- [Roadmap](docs/roadmap.md): Proposed features with acceptance criteria; not implemented promises.
- [Validation](VALIDATION.md): Test evidence and known gaps.
- [Security](SECURITY.md): Local trust boundaries and reporting.
- [Upstream sources](SOURCES.md): Attribution and experimental integrations.

Read capabilities and live schemas before acting. This file is a navigation aid, not a claim that every AI client automatically ingests it.
